Attached: 1 image

Most goal apps hide progress behind another screen. I wanted something physical.

So I built CutDone: turn one vague goal into small printable steps, put them somewhere visible, and tear off each completed step.

This is my 12-month 2027 challenge strip.

Make yours: https://cutdone.com/2027?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutdone_2027&utm_content=12_month_strip

What would you put on your 2027 list?
